The regression test covers this contract at [reference.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/reference.rs:718). No unsafe code, PID handling, event-log, gate, or atomic-write regressions found.

The committed-reference freshness guard is present at [reference.rs](/home/vkaskivuo/Projects/just-in-time/crates/jit/src/storage/reference.rs:786).
